item.title: Many attend memorial Mass for local legal legend Al Flora
item.description: More than 50 people, from lawyers to judges to councilmen, honored legal legend Attorney Albert J. Flora Jr. at his memorial Mass on Friday evening at King’s College Chapel of Christ the King.

item.title: Trump rules out talks absent Iran’s ‘unconditional surrender’ as Israel strikes Lebanon
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — U.S. President Donald Trump said Friday that he would not seek a deal with Iran without the country’s “unconditional surrender” as Washington warned of a forthcoming bombing campaign that officials said would be the most intense of the weeklong conflict.

item.title: Former Democratic presidents remember the late Rev. Jesse Jackson during final public tribute
item.description: CHICAGO — From former presidents to an NBA Hall of Famer to prominent pastors, stories of the Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr.’s influence on politics, corporate boardrooms and picket lines loomed large Friday at a celebration honoring the late civil rights leader.

item.title: Ravens land Raiders star Crosby for two first-round picks in blockbuster trade
item.description: Five-time Pro Bowl edge rusher Maxx Crosby is heading to the Baltimore Ravens, two people with knowledge of the trade told The Associated Press on Friday night.

item.title: Penguins’ Malkin suspended 5 games for slashing Sabres’ Dahlin
item.description: NEW YORK — Pittsburgh’s Evgeni Malkin was suspended for five games for slashing Buffalo defenseman Rasmus Dahlin on the head, a punishment that will cost the Penguins forward nearly $160,000, the NHL announced Friday night.

item.title: Hazleton Area’s Gabe Benyo set to wrestle for 3A state title at 114 pounds
item.description: With a 4-2 decision win in Friday night’s semifinals, Hazleton Area sophomore Gabe Benyo has put himself just one win away from a state wrestling championship.

item.title: PIAA Basketball roundup: Dallas boys, Redeemer girls win in first round
item.description: Three Mountaineers finished in double-figures as Dallas opened up play in the PIAA Class 4A boys basketball playoffs with a 57-48 road win over Northwestern Lehigh on Friday night.

item.title: PIAA Boys Basketball: Crestwood turns back late surge to beat Holy Ghost Prep
item.description: BENSALEM TWP. — Perhaps Ayden Agapito said it best.

item.title: PIAA Girls Basketball: Hazleton Area routs Garnet Valley in state opener
item.description: HAZLE TWP. — Hazleton Area picked up in the state playoffs right where it left off last weekend in the District 2 playoffs: overwhelming opponents from the jump and pressing them into submission.

item.title: PIAA Girls Basketball: Wyoming Seminary hangs on for rare state win
item.description: MUNCY — Wyoming Seminary ran the gamut of emotions Friday night in the program’s first PIAA state playoff game in 27 years.
